about: list_work_items refused: shared credential, no caller identity

content.text: this server authenticates to midPoint with a shared/technical account and this request carries no caller identity, so a self-scoped answer would describe that account rather than you; use resource-server mode to pass the end user's identity, or set identity.credentialIsShared=false in MIDPOINT_MCP_CONFIG if the configured credentials really are one person's
